exam_set.title: Practice Set 1
exam_set.description: Textbook Practice — Book 1, Chapter 8, Practice Set 1

questions.jp: GUIの部品の一つであるラジオボタンの用途として、適切なものはどれか。
questions.romaji: GUI no buhin no hitotsu de aru rajio botan no yōto to shite, tekisetsu na mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which is an appropriate use of a radio button, a GUI component?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 幾つかの項目について、それぞれの項目を選択するかどうかを指定する。
options.romaji: Ikutsuka no kōmoku ni tsuite, sorezore no kōmoku o sentaku suru ka dō ka o shitei suru.
options.en: For several items, specify independently whether each item is selected.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 幾つかの選択項目から一つを選ぶときに、選択項目にないものはテキストボックスに入力する。
options.romaji: Ikutsuka no sentaku kōmoku kara hitotsu o erabu toki ni, sentaku kōmoku ni nai mono wa tekisuto bokkusu ni nyūryoku suru.
options.en: When choosing one of several items, enter an unlisted choice in a text box.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 互いに排他的な幾つかの選択項目から一つを選ぶ。
options.romaji: Tagai ni haitateki na ikutsuka no sentaku kōmoku kara hitotsu o erabu.
options.en: Choose one item from several mutually exclusive choices.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 特定の項目を選択することによって表示される一覧形式の項目から一つを選ぶ。
options.romaji: Tokutei no kōmoku o sentaku suru koto ni yotte hyōji sareru ichiran keishiki no kōmoku kara hitotsu o erabu.
options.en: Choose one item from a list displayed by selecting a particular control.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Radio buttons form a group where selecting one choice turns the others off.

Technical breakdown:
1. Radio buttons represent mutually exclusive alternatives.
2. Exactly one member of the group is selected at a time.
3. This differs from checkboxes, editable combo boxes, and drop-down lists.

Japanese keywords to remember:
排他的 = haitateki = mutually exclusive
選択項目 = sentaku kōmoku = choice item
ラジオボタン = rajio botan = radio button

Why the best solution works:
ウ precisely describes selecting one item from mutually exclusive alternatives.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Independent yes/no selection for each item is a checkbox pattern.

イ:
Allowing an unlisted text entry describes an editable combo box.

エ:
Opening a list and choosing one item describes a drop-down list.

Memory trick:
Radio station: tune to one channel at a time.

Correct answer: ウ

questions.jp: ある商店では、約200品目の商品を取り扱っている。商品データの新規登録画面の入力項目のうち、入力方式としてプルダウンメニューを用いるのが適しているものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Aru shōten de wa, yaku nihyaku hinmoku no shōhin o toriatsukatte iru. Shōhin dēta no shinki tōroku gamen no nyūryoku kōmoku no uchi, nyūryoku hōshiki to shite purudaun menyū o mochiiru no ga tekishite iru mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: A store handles about 200 products. Which field on a new-product registration screen is suitable for input through a pull-down menu?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 商品番号：5桁の英数字項目で、商品ごとに付番する。
options.romaji: Shōhin bangō: go-keta no eisūji kōmoku de, shōhin-goto ni fuban suru.
options.en: Product number: a five-character alphanumeric value assigned to each product.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 商品名：40字以内の日本語項目で、商品ごとに命名する。
options.romaji: Shōhin-mei: yonjū-ji inai no Nihongo kōmoku de, shōhin-goto ni meimei suru.
options.en: Product name: a Japanese text value of at most 40 characters, named per product.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 商品区分：10字以内の日本語項目で、5区分ある。
options.romaji: Shōhin kubun: jū-ji inai no Nihongo kōmoku de, go-kubun aru.
options.en: Product category: a Japanese text value of at most 10 characters, with five categories.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 価格：6桁の数字項目で、範囲は10,000～100,000円である。
options.romaji: Kakaku: roku-keta no sūji kōmoku de, han'i wa ichiman kara jūman-en de aru.
options.en: Price: a six-digit numeric value ranging from 10,000 to 100,000 yen.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
A pull-down works best when users choose from a small fixed list. Five product categories are easy to show completely.

Technical breakdown:
1. Pull-down menus constrain input to predefined values.
2. Five categories are few enough to scan quickly.
3. IDs, names, and prices have many possible values and require generation or text/numeric entry.

Japanese keywords to remember:
商品区分 = shōhin kubun = product category
入力項目 = nyūryoku kōmoku = input field
プルダウンメニュー = purudaun menyū = pull-down menu

Why the best solution works:
ウ has exactly five fixed alternatives, preventing spelling variation and invalid categories.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
About 200 unique product numbers would make a long, inefficient list.

イ:
Product names are free text and differ per product.

エ:
A large numeric range is better served by validated numeric input.

Memory trick:
Small fixed set: pull it down.

Correct answer: ウ

questions.jp: Webコンテンツのユーザビリティの説明として、適切なものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Web kontentsu no yūzabiriti no setsumei to shite, tekisetsu na mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which statement correctly describes the usability of web content?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 障がい、年齢、性別、国籍などにかかわらず、だれもが使える設計をいう。
options.romaji: Shōgai, nenrei, seibetsu, kokuseki nado ni kakawarazu, daremo ga tsukaeru sekkei o iu.
options.en: A design usable by everyone regardless of disability, age, sex, nationality, and similar attributes.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 障がい者や高齢者がサービスを支障なく操作又は利用できる機能をいう。
options.romaji: Shōgaisha ya kōreisha ga sābisu o shishō naku sōsa mata wa riyō dekiru kinō o iu.
options.en: A function enabling people with disabilities or older people to operate or use a service without difficulty.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 障がい者や高齢者に負担を与えない設計をいう。
options.romaji: Shōgaisha ya kōreisha ni futan o ataenai sekkei o iu.
options.en: A design that imposes no burden on people with disabilities or older people.

options.label: エ
options.jp: どれだけ利用者がストレスを感じずに、目標とする要求が達成できるかをいう。
options.romaji: Dore dake riyōsha ga sutoresu o kanjizu ni, mokuhyō to suru yōkyū ga tassei dekiru ka o iu.
options.en: The degree to which users can achieve their intended goals without feeling stress.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Usability asks whether people can complete their goal effectively and comfortably, not merely whether access is technically possible.

Technical breakdown:
1. Usability concerns effectiveness, efficiency, and satisfaction in a usage context.
2. Achieving the intended requirement measures effectiveness.
3. Low stress reflects ease and satisfaction.
4. The other choices focus on universal design or accessibility.

Japanese keywords to remember:
ユーザビリティ = yūzabiriti = usability
利用者 = riyōsha = user
目標 = mokuhyō = goal
達成 = tassei = achievement

Why the best solution works:
エ connects user comfort with successful goal completion, the core usability idea.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Design for everyone regardless of personal attributes is universal design.

イ:
Removing barriers for disabled and older users describes accessibility.

ウ:
Avoiding burdens for specific groups is an accessibility-oriented design aim, not the full usability definition.

Memory trick:
Usability: users reach goals with little friction.

Correct answer: エ

questions.jp: 使用性（ユーザビリティ）の規格（JIS Z 8521）では、使用性を、『ある製品が、指定された利用者によって、指定された利用の状況下で、指定された目的を達成するために用いられる際の、有効さ、効率及び利用者の満足度の度合い』と定義している。この定義中の『利用者の満足度』を評価するのに適した方法はどれか。
questions.romaji: Shiyōsei (yūzabiriti) no kikaku (JIS Z 8521) de wa, shiyōsei o, 'aru seihin ga, shitei sareta riyōsha ni yotte, shitei sareta riyō no jōkyō-ka de, shitei sareta mokuteki o tassei suru tame ni mochiirareru sai no, yūkōsa, kōritsu oyobi riyōsha no manzokudo no doai' to teigi shite iru. Kono teigi-chū no 'riyōsha no manzokudo' o hyōka suru no ni tekishita hōhō wa dore ka.
questions.en: JIS Z 8521 defines usability as the degree of effectiveness, efficiency, and user satisfaction with which specified users use a product to achieve specified goals in a specified context. Which method is suitable for evaluating the 'user satisfaction' in this definition?

options.label: ア
options.jp: インタビュー法
options.romaji: intabyū-hō
options.en: interview method

options.label: イ
options.jp: ヒューリスティック評価
options.romaji: hyūrisutikku hyōka
options.en: heuristic evaluation

options.label: ウ
options.jp: ユーザビリティテスト
options.romaji: yūzabiriti tesuto
options.en: usability test

options.label: エ
options.jp: ログデータ分析法
options.romaji: rogu dēta bunseki-hō
options.en: log-data analysis method

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Satisfaction is a feeling, so ask users directly about their experience. An interview can capture opinions that timings and logs cannot.

Technical breakdown:
1. Satisfaction is subjective.
2. Interviews elicit users' impressions, comfort, frustration, and preferences.
3. Heuristic review gives expert judgments; tests and logs primarily provide observed behavior and efficiency evidence.

Japanese keywords to remember:
利用者の満足度 = riyōsha no manzokudo = user satisfaction
インタビュー法 = intabyū-hō = interview method
有効さ = yūkōsa = effectiveness
効率 = kōritsu = efficiency

Why the best solution works:
ア obtains the user's own qualitative assessment and directly measures subjective satisfaction.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ:
Experts inspect conformance to usability principles; this does not directly measure actual users' satisfaction.

ウ:
A usability test observes task success, errors, and time, although questionnaires or interviews may supplement it.

エ:
Logs reveal behavior such as paths and frequency but not why users felt satisfied.

Memory trick:
To measure a feeling, ask its owner.

Correct answer: ア

questions.jp: ビットマップフォントよりも、アウトラインフォントの利用が適しているケースはどれか。
questions.romaji: Bittomappu fonto yori mo, autorain fonto no riyō ga tekishite iru kēsu wa dore ka.
questions.en: In which case is an outline font more suitable than a bitmap font?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 英数字だけでなく、漢字も表示する。
options.romaji: Eisūji dake de naku, kanji mo hyōji suru.
options.en: Display kanji as well as letters and numbers.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 各文字の幅を一定にして表示する。
options.romaji: Kaku moji no haba o ittei ni shite hyōji suru.
options.en: Display every character with a fixed width.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 画面上にできるだけ高速に表示する。
options.romaji: Gamen-jō ni dekiru dake kōsoku ni hyōji suru.
options.en: Display on screen as quickly as possible.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 文字を任意の倍率に拡大して表示する。
options.romaji: Moji o nin'i no bairitsu ni kakudai shite hyōji suru.
options.en: Enlarge and display characters at any scale.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Outline fonts store shapes as lines and curves. Those shapes can be scaled large or small and redrawn smoothly.

Technical breakdown:
1. Bitmap fonts store pixels for particular sizes.
2. Enlarging a bitmap exposes blocky pixels.
3. Outline fonts mathematically describe contours and rasterize them at the requested size.
4. Arbitrary enlargement is therefore their key advantage.

Japanese keywords to remember:
アウトラインフォント = autorain fonto = outline font
ビットマップフォント = bittomappu fonto = bitmap font
任意の倍率 = nin'i no bairitsu = arbitrary scale
拡大 = kakudai = enlargement

Why the best solution works:
エ uses the resolution-independent contour representation of outline fonts.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Either font format can include kanji if the glyph set is provided.

イ:
Fixed width is a font-spacing design choice, not a bitmap-versus-outline distinction.

ウ:
Pre-rendered bitmap glyphs may be faster to display in simple environments.

Memory trick:
Outline = scalable shape; bitmap = fixed pixels.

Correct answer: エ

questions.jp: 音声のサンプリングを1秒間に11,000回行い、サンプリングした値をそれぞれ8ビットのデータとして記録する。このとき、512×10^6バイトの容量をもつフラッシュメモリに記録できる音声の長さは、最大何分か。
questions.romaji: Onsei no sanpuringu o ichi-byōkan ni ichiman-issen-kai okonai, sanpuringu shita atai o sorezore hachi-bitto no dēta to shite kiroku suru. Kono toki, gohyaku-jūni kakeru jū no roku-jō baito no yōryō o motsu furasshu memori ni kiroku dekiru onsei no nagasa wa, saidai nan-pun ka.
questions.en: Audio is sampled 11,000 times per second, and each sampled value is recorded as 8 bits. What is the maximum number of minutes of audio that can be stored in flash memory with a capacity of 512 × 10^6 bytes?

options.label: ア
options.romaji: nanajū-nana-fun
options.en: 77 minutes

options.label: イ
options.romaji: kyūjū-roppun
options.en: 96 minutes

options.label: ウ
options.romaji: nanahyaku-nanajū-go-fun
options.en: 775 minutes

options.label: エ
options.romaji: kyūhyaku-rokujū-kyū-fun
options.en: 969 minutes

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Each sample is exactly one byte. Divide available bytes by bytes used each second, then convert seconds to minutes.

Technical breakdown:
1. Formula: time = capacity ÷ data rate.
2. One sample = 8 bits = 1 byte.
3. Data rate = 11,000 samples/s × 1 byte/sample = 11,000 bytes/s.
4. Time = 512 × 10^6 bytes ÷ 11,000 bytes/s = 46,545.45 seconds.
5. Minutes = 46,545.45 ÷ 60 = 775.76 minutes.
6. Only complete maximum minutes fit, so the answer is 775 minutes.

Japanese keywords to remember:
サンプリング = sanpuringu = sampling
容量 = yōryō = capacity
8ビット = hachi-bitto = 8 bits
最大何分 = saidai nan-pun = maximum number of minutes

Why the best solution works:
ウ matches the capacity-to-rate calculation after converting bytes and seconds correctly.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
77 is about one tenth of the correct result, as if a decimal factor were misplaced.

イ:
96 does not follow from the stated 11,000-byte-per-second rate and capacity.

エ:
969 overestimates the duration; it would require a lower data rate than given.

Memory trick:
Samples × bytes per sample = bytes per second.

Correct answer: ウ

questions.jp: 3次元グラフィックス処理におけるクリッピングの説明はどれか。
questions.romaji: San-jigen gurafikkusu shori ni okeru kurippingu no setsumei wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which statement describes clipping in three-dimensional graphics processing?

options.label: ア
options.jp: CG映像作成における最終段階として、物体のデータをディスプレイに描画できるように映像化する処理である。
options.romaji: CG eizō sakusei ni okeru saishū dankai to shite, buttai no dēta o disupurei ni byōga dekiru yō ni eizōka suru shori de aru.
options.en: As the final CG-image creation stage, convert object data into an image that can be drawn on a display.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 画像表示領域にウィンドウを定義し、ウィンドウの外側を除去し、内側の見える部分だけを取り出す処理である。
options.romaji: Gazō hyōji ryōiki ni uindō o teigi shi, uindō no sotogawa o jokyo shi, uchigawa no mieru bubun dake o toridasu shori de aru.
options.en: Define a window in the image display area, remove what lies outside it, and retain only the visible part inside.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: スクリーンの画素数が有限であるために図形の境界近くに生じる、階段状のギザギザを目立たなくする処理である。
options.romaji: Sukurīn no gasosū ga yūgen de aru tame ni zukei no kyōkai chikaku ni shōjiru, kaidan-jō no gizagiza o medatanaku suru shori de aru.
options.en: Reduce the visibility of stair-step jaggedness near shape boundaries caused by the finite number of screen pixels.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 立体感を生じさせるために、物体の表面に陰影を付ける処理である。
options.romaji: Rittaikan o shōji saseru tame ni, buttai no hyōmen ni in'ei o tsukeru shori de aru.
options.en: Add shading to object surfaces to create a three-dimensional impression.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Clipping is like trimming a photograph to its frame: content outside the viewing window is discarded.

Technical breakdown:
1. A viewing region or window defines what can appear.
2. Primitives fully outside are removed.
3. Primitives crossing the boundary are cut at it.
4. Only visible portions continue through rendering.

Japanese keywords to remember:
クリッピング = kurippingu = clipping
表示領域 = hyōji ryōiki = display region
ウィンドウ = uindō = window
除去 = jokyo = removal

Why the best solution works:
イ exactly states window definition, outside removal, and inside retention.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Converting scene data into display pixels describes rendering.

ウ:
Smoothing stair-step edges describes anti-aliasing.

エ:
Adding light and shadow to surfaces describes shading.

Memory trick:
Clip means cut at the window edge.

Correct answer: イ

questions.jp: 液晶ディスプレイなどの表示装置において、傾いた直線を滑らかに表示する手法はどれか。
questions.romaji: Ekishō disupurei nado no hyōji sōchi ni oite, katamuita chokusen o nameraka ni hyōji suru shuhō wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which technique displays a slanted line smoothly on a display device such as an LCD?

options.label: ア
options.jp: アンチエイリアシング
options.romaji: anchi eiriashingu
options.en: anti-aliasing

options.label: イ
options.jp: テクスチャマッピング
options.romaji: tekusucha mappingu
options.en: texture mapping

options.label: ウ
options.jp: モーフィング
options.romaji: mōfingu
options.en: morphing

options.label: エ
options.jp: レイトレーシング
options.romaji: rei torēshingu
options.en: ray tracing

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Pixels form a square grid, so diagonal lines can look like stairs. Anti-aliasing blends edge pixels to make those stairs less noticeable.

Technical breakdown:
1. Sampling a continuous slanted line onto discrete pixels creates aliasing.
2. Edge pixels receive intermediate coverage or color values.
3. The blended boundary appears smoother at normal viewing distance.

Japanese keywords to remember:
傾いた直線 = katamuita chokusen = slanted line
滑らか = nameraka = smooth
アンチエイリアシング = anchi eiriashingu = anti-aliasing
画素 = gasō = pixel

Why the best solution works:
ア directly suppresses jagged pixel-grid artifacts along diagonal edges.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ:
Texture mapping attaches an image pattern to a surface.

ウ:
Morphing gradually transforms one shape or image into another.

エ:
Ray tracing simulates light paths for image generation, not specifically diagonal smoothing.

Memory trick:
Anti-aliasing attacks jagged aliases.

Correct answer: ア

questions.jp: テクスチャマッピングを説明したものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Tekusucha mappingu o setsumei shita mono wa dore ka.

options.label: ア
options.jp: 光源からの反射や屈折、透過を計算し描画していく。
options.romaji: Kōgen kara no hansha ya kussetsu, tōka o keisan shi byōga shite iku.
options.en: Calculate and render reflection, refraction, and transmission from light sources.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 光源と物体の形状などに基づいて、表示するときに陰影をつける。
options.romaji: Kōgen to buttai no keijō nado ni motozuite, hyōji suru toki ni in'ei o tsukeru.
options.en: Add shading during display based on light sources, object shape, and related information.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 表示画面からはみ出す箇所をあらかじめ見つけ、表示対象から外す。
options.romaji: Hyōji gamen kara hamidasu kasho o arakajime mitsuke, hyōji taishō kara hazusu.
options.en: Find portions extending beyond the display area in advance and exclude them from display.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 物体の表面に画像を貼り付けることによって、表面の質感を表現する。
options.romaji: Buttai no hyōmen ni gazō o haritsukeru koto ni yotte, hyōmen no shitsukan o hyōgen suru.
options.en: Represent surface texture by applying an image to an object's surface.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Texture mapping wraps a picture around a 3D object, like putting a printed label on a plain box.

Technical breakdown:
1. A texture is a 2D image.
2. Texture coordinates map image positions to positions on a model surface.
3. During rendering, sampled texture colors give the surface visual detail without extra geometry.

Japanese keywords to remember:
物体の表面 = buttai no hyōmen = object surface
画像を貼り付ける = gazō o haritsukeru = apply an image
質感 = shitsukan = texture or material feel

Why the best solution works:
エ describes attaching an image to a surface to express its visual texture.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Following reflection, refraction, and transmission paths describes ray tracing.

イ:
Computing illumination-based light and dark values describes shading.

ウ:
Removing portions outside the display region describes clipping.

Memory trick:
Texture mapping maps a picture onto a surface.

Correct answer: エ

questions.jp: H.264/MPEG-4 AVCの説明として、適切なものはどれか。
questions.romaji: H.264/MPEG-4 AVC no setsumei to shite, tekisetsu na mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which statement correctly describes H.264/MPEG-4 AVC?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 5.1チャンネルサラウンドシステムで使用されている音声圧縮技術
options.romaji: Go-ten-ichi channeru saraundo shisutemu de shiyō sarete iru onsei asshuku gijutsu
options.en: Audio compression technology used in 5.1-channel surround systems

options.label: イ
options.jp: 携帯電話で使用されている音声圧縮技術
options.romaji: Keitai denwa de shiyō sarete iru onsei asshuku gijutsu
options.en: Audio compression technology used in mobile phones

options.label: ウ
options.jp: デジタルカメラで使用されている静止画圧縮技術
options.romaji: Dejitaru kamera de shiyō sarete iru seishiga asshuku gijutsu
options.en: Still-image compression technology used in digital cameras

options.label: エ
options.jp: ワンセグ放送で使用されている動画圧縮技術
options.romaji: Wansegu hōsō de shiyō sarete iru dōga asshuku gijutsu
options.en: Video compression technology used in One-Seg broadcasting

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
H.264 compresses moving pictures efficiently. Japan's One-Seg mobile television service used it for video.

Technical breakdown:
1. AVC means Advanced Video Coding.
2. H.264/MPEG-4 AVC is a lossy video codec using spatial and temporal prediction.
3. One-Seg broadcasting uses this standard for its moving images.
4. Audio and still images use other codec families.

Japanese keywords to remember:
動画圧縮 = dōga asshuku = video compression
ワンセグ放送 = wansegu hōsō = One-Seg broadcasting
静止画 = seishiga = still image
音声圧縮 = onsei asshuku = audio compression

Why the best solution works:
エ identifies both the correct media type, video, and a real application of H.264/AVC.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
5.1 surround audio commonly uses audio codecs such as Dolby Digital, not H.264 video coding.

イ:
Mobile speech uses speech/audio codecs rather than H.264.

ウ:
Digital-camera still images commonly use JPEG-family compression.

Memory trick:
AVC: Advanced Video Coding.

Correct answer: エ

questions.jp: 頻繁に行う操作を効率よく行えるようにしたユーザーインタフェースはどれか。
questions.romaji: Hinpan ni okonau sōsa o kōritsu yoku okonaeru yō ni shita yūzā intafēsu wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which user-interface feature makes frequently performed operations more efficient?

options.label: ア
options.jp: Undo機能（元に戻す）
options.romaji: Undo kinō (moto ni modosu)
options.en: Undo function (restore the previous state)

options.label: イ
options.jp: オンラインヘルプ
options.romaji: onrain herupu
options.en: online help

options.label: ウ
options.jp: ショートカットキー
options.romaji: shōtokatto kī
options.en: shortcut keys

options.label: エ
options.jp: プログレスバー
options.romaji: puroguressu bā
options.en: progress bar

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
A shortcut key lets an experienced user trigger a common command immediately from the keyboard instead of navigating menus repeatedly.

Technical breakdown:
1. Frequent tasks accumulate interaction cost.
2. A keyboard shortcut reduces navigation and pointing steps.
3. The command becomes faster while the ordinary menu can remain available.
4. The other controls support recovery, learning, or status feedback.

Japanese keywords to remember:
頻繁に行う操作 = hinpan ni okonau sōsa = frequently performed operation
効率よく = kōritsu yoku = efficiently
ショートカットキー = shōtokatto kī = shortcut key

Why the best solution works:
ウ directly shortens the action sequence for commands used often.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Undo recovers from an unwanted action; it does not accelerate the normal command itself.

イ:
Online help explains usage but usually adds steps rather than shortening repeated operations.

エ:
A progress bar reports completion status for a running task and does not invoke commands faster.

Memory trick:
Frequent route? Take the shortcut.

Correct answer: ウ
